historical_baseline.note: Actual compact JUNIT_MODULE totals were read from this job. The split into five inferred-expectation functions and four retained guards is static source classification, not a new runtime report.

current_contract.demand_dto: Every nonblank original question remains one full-span unresolved RetrievalNeed in an unknown AdmissionDemand, with exact raw text and literal hard_exact identities. Empty input is distinct from unsupported input.
current_contract.literal_identity: All six archived quoted values remain explicit symbols at original character offsets. Canonical phrase is literal identity; raw QueueHub/queuehub stay distinct while hard_exact uses documented casefolding.
current_contract.unknown_semantics: Neither equal compiled unknown demands nor caller-supplied identical complete MeaningSlot DTOs establish supported natural-language equivalence. same_supported_meaning and the whole-question adapter remain false.
current_contract.query_plan: Original query and explicitly supplied good/changed host lookup bytes remain separate direct/host_lookup lanes without inferred relation or parent coverage.
current_contract.finite_reference_resolution: A separate pure CatalogSource control preserves positive finite membership while testing foreign scope, prefix-neighbor paths, missing/incomplete catalogs and ambiguity. It is not evidence-body or filesystem access proof.
current_contract.retained_rule: All four retained functions remain independently collected. Their full function ASTs are frozen against the original archive. Source preservation checks do not execute or certify their behavior.
current_contract.mutant_first_assertion: Identical forged complete AdmissionDemand/MeaningSlot values must fail the named no-equivalence assertion when the real production function is changed from False to True.
current_contract.retirement_rule: Only the five marked functions may be considered for retirement in a separate reviewed change after an exact-published-SHA green baseline and one expected named mutant kill with no errors/skips. All four live guards and their helpers remain collected.
current_contract.scope_limit: No production or retrieval changes, no selected test deletion, no source-binding/quality/installed/client proof, and no claim that alias/intent proof covers this API.
